title: Dev ↔ QA Loop
summary: The NEXUS task loop: a developer implements one task, a QA agent tests it against the acceptance criteria, failures loop back with specific feedback (max 3 attempts), and exhausted or blocked tasks are escalated.

acceptance.default: The task works as described, is tested, and introduces no regressions.

context.description: Specs, architecture, or constraints the developer needs

nodes.verdict_guide: PASS = every criterion demonstrably met. FAIL = fixable issues remain (list them). BLOCKED = cannot be completed by the developer (missing access, contradictory spec, external dependency).

nodes.task: The task '{{input.task}}' did not pass QA (loop status: {{nodes.attempts.status}}, last verdict: {{nodes.attempts.verdict}}, after {{nodes.attempts.iterations}} attempt(s)). Write a NEXUS escalation report: failure history, root cause, and a recommended resolution (reassign, decompose, revise approach, accept with known limitations, or defer).
